cases.summary: Happy path and a full-physical partial block.
oracles: Baseline output token IDs and finish reason.
Source/destination checksums for first, middle, and last layer Main K/V and Indexer roles.
Whole physical checksum for the partial tail with token-state validity.
success_criteria: Each Decode TP reads only fixed leaders 0 or 4 in the explicitly routed Prefill DP.
Indexer terminal success precedes one Main submission per worker.
Exact TP RECEIVE_COMPLETE precedes cache-hit visibility.
Output and cache oracles match baseline.
failure_evidence: Non-leader payload, phase overlap/reversal, missing TP result, unexpected retry, placement mismatch, or oracle mismatch.
cleanup: Collect Job, Pod, event, lifecycle, session, and NPU evidence.
Run exact session cleanup for this RUN_ID/case.
Delete only the rendered NPU-01 Job and ConfigMap, then prove resource counters returned to the pre-case baseline.

cases.summary: Multi-block receive, sustained Decode, and fused D2H validity.
oracles: Per-block cache checksums at selected layers.
FUSED_D2H range, destination, and confirmed-prefix snapshots before and after D2H_COMPLETE.
success_criteria: No block range gap or overlap and partial tails use full physical lengths.
D2H starts at the confirmed boundary and exact TP D2H_COMPLETE advances validity monotonically.
Output and cache oracles match baseline.
failure_evidence: Block mapping gap/overlap, stale command acceptance, validity regression/overflow, non-fail-fast D2H failure, or oracle mismatch.
cleanup: Wait for every reachable fused operation terminal state.
Run exact session cleanup and delete only NPU-02 Job/ConfigMap.
Do not synthesize completion for an unquiesced operation.

cases.summary: Concurrency, request-lifetime reservation pressure, and per-step HOL admission.
oracles: Baseline output/cache results for all three requests.
Step-indexed reservation ledger and scheduler/worker ownership timeline.
success_criteria: Old holds capacity, head misses, and young is gated for that step even when it would fit.
No partial ownership, oversubscription, cross-request write, or duplicate release.
The next step retries in original order and all final oracles match.
failure_evidence: HOL bypass, oversubscription, ownership leak, early/duplicate release, cross-request write, no progress, or oracle mismatch.
cleanup: Release the admission barrier before cleanup.
Terminate all case requests and run exact session cleanup.
Delete only NPU-03 Job/ConfigMap and prove reservation/delayed-block counters return exactly to baseline.

cases.summary: Indexer-before-Main ordering with request/TP/phase-specific final failures.
oracles: Separate clean subruns for INDEXER_D2D and MAIN_D2RH final failure.
Baseline output/cache oracle, phase timeline, and Main checksum before/after each subrun.
success_criteria: Indexer final failure never submits Main and emits TRANSFER_FAILED(INDEXER_D2D).
Main final failure emits TRANSFER_FAILED(MAIN_D2RH) and never RECEIVE_COMPLETE.
No connector outer retry and no local success is promoted to a cache hit.
failure_evidence: Main after Indexer failure, wrong phase, RECEIVE_COMPLETE, unbounded retry, untracked write, fault miss, or oracle mismatch.
cleanup: Disable and prove removal of the exact fault rule after each subrun.
Run exact session cleanup and delete only NPU-04 Job/ConfigMap.
A missing phase fault capability keeps this case planned/not run; Pod kill is not a substitute.

cases.summary: Exact TP terminal barrier and all-TP full replay.
oracles: Every command/epoch/TP result, preserved_main_tokens value, and replay block trace.
success_criteria: A missing TP remains pending without replay.
After exact terminal coverage every TP receives PREPARE_REPLAY, reports REPLAY_READY, and has zero preserved Main validity.
Decode replays from token zero and rewrites complete Indexer/Main with matching final oracles.
failure_evidence: Early replay, inferred missing rank, stale/conflicting result changing ownership, retained Main validity, suffix-only replay, or oracle mismatch.
cleanup: Release the TP barrier and phase fault even after failure.
Collect every reachable terminal result, run exact session cleanup, and delete only NPU-05 Job/ConfigMap.
Prove all TP replay state, reservations, and sessions returned to baseline.

cases.summary: Preemption epoch rebind and confirmed Main reuse.
oracles: Preemption-boundary Main checksum, old/new epoch, Indexer IDs, reservation identity, replay trace, D2H ranges, and DsaPreemptionEvidence.
success_criteria: Old epoch retires, Indexer rebinds, and Main reservation identity/capacity remains stable.
Proven Main prefix is not D2H-written twice; stale old-epoch results cannot restore ownership.
Evidence fields and final output/cache oracles match.
failure_evidence: Old Indexer reuse, Main reservation replacement/release, duplicate confirmed-prefix write, wrong preserved boundary, stale acceptance, or oracle mismatch.
cleanup: Allow old/new epoch operations to reach terminal state.
Run exact session cleanup and delete only NPU-06 Job/ConfigMap.
Prove one Main release and removal of both epoch trackers.

cases.summary: Cancellation drain-and-ack during receive and fused D2H.
oracles: Quiesced, DONE_RECVING_MSG attempt, ordinary finished_recving, delayed-block release, and address ownership timeline.
success_criteria: No new command starts after cancellation and unquiesced ownership remains isolated.
Each worker attempts source notification before one ordinary ack; all-worker completion precedes release-once.
Duplicate cancellation and late completion are no-ops with no late write.
failure_evidence: Early reuse/release, new operation, notification/ack inversion, duplicate ack, partial-worker cleanup, late write, or resource leak.
cleanup: Release every cancellation barrier and wait for actual drain.
Run exact session cleanup and delete only NPU-07 Job/ConfigMap.
Prove source notification, Main/Indexer ownership, delayed blocks, and worker command state returned to baseline.

oracles: Ordinary V1 source/destination checksum at selected layers/blocks and connector-type trace.
success_criteria: Only ordinary V1 metadata, scheduler, transfer, and completion paths are observed.
No DSA envelope, Swapped Main lifetime reservation, split Indexer/Main phase, or DSA typed result exists.
Output/cache oracles match and no resource leaks remain.
failure_evidence: Any DSA-only state/allocation, ordinary metadata/transfer regression, unexpected retry, oracle mismatch, or resource leak.
cleanup: Run exact default-V1 session cleanup.
Delete only NPU-08 Job/ConfigMap, then delete the exact rendered default-V1 manifest.
Prove all run-owned V1 Pods and NPU allocations are released.
